claim: With m2 fixed at 0.5 on data_seed 1, both N=64 seeds keep force well above control at step 12000, with force best at layer 1 in both. Seed 22 has R² 0.8686 against a control of 0.6200 (margin 0.249, normalised 0.65), and seed 23 has R² 0.8467 against 0.6322 (margin 0.215, normalised 0.58). Accel_step has smaller raw margins but larger normalised ones: seed 22 R² 0.957 against control 0.773 (margin 0.184, normalised 0.81), seed 23 R² 0.945 against 0.769 at layer 3 (margin 0.176, normalised 0.76). Only seed 22 has a completed N=128 partner. Comparing layer 1 in both arms, its N=64 minus N=128 force gap is about 0.086 (0.8686 vs about 0.783, the N=128 value taken from the trajectory). The seed 23 N=128 run is still going, so its gap is not computed.
confidence_note: Both N=64 runs completed all 12000 steps and pass every N=64-side condition. Force margin is at least 0.1 in both. Normalised accel_step is 0.81 and 0.76, both inside [0.60, 0.85]. The horizon check passes: step-6000 force R² was 0.848 for seed 22 and 0.836 for seed 23, compared with 0.8663 and 0.8465 from the 6000-step runs. Those differences, 0.018 and 0.010, are within 0.03, but they come from the max-over-layers trajectory field because there is no per-checkpoint probes_final. The verdict is inconclusive because the hypothesis needs both seeds, and the N=128 seed 23 run (run-20261014-082647-eac3) has not finished. For seed 22, the N=128 value of about 0.783 at layer 1 comes from the trajectory's max-over-layers field, and its probes_final was not in the context. Same-layer control plus margin would give about 0.637 + 0.146, which agrees, but that is not the required probes_final read. Seed 22's gap was about 0.089 at step 6000 and about 0.086 at step 12000, with both arms still gaining about 0.002 force R² per 500 steps. That supports a constant offset rather than N=128 catching up. The verdict would become supported if N=128 seed 23 finishes with layer-1 force R² of 0.807 or less, a gap of at least 0.04, and seed 22's probes_final confirms about 0.783. It would become inconclusive in the other direction, or move toward refuted, if seed 23's gap falls to 0.02 or below.
